dimensions.label: Data sensitivity
dimensions.help: What categories of information will the tool process?
choices: Health, employee, or other highly sensitive data

dimensions.label: Impact on people
dimensions.help: How much could the output affect a person?
choices: Clinical care, employment, or essential services

dimensions.label: AI autonomy
choices: Staff chooses whether to use output

dimensions.label: Human oversight
dimensions.help: Who checks the output before it is used?
choices: A qualified person verifies every output

dimensions.label: Vendor assurance
dimensions.help: How much assurance has the vendor provided?
choices: No assurance or unclear data use

dimensions.label: Transparency
dimensions.help: Can people understand and challenge the output?
choices: Clear explanations and a challenge process
Opaque outputs with no challenge process

dimensions.label: Legal & regulatory exposure
dimensions.help: Does the use touch regulated activities?
choices: Regulated care, employment, or sensitive data
